messages:
Maya (Design): dropped a compact mock of the trace header — https://rwd/fig/trace-header-compact.png. main asks: 1) legend order (severity-first?), 2) where to surface 'copy correlation id', 3) make 'Export' feel discoverable for bulk ops
Felipe (Product): good set of questions. my vote: severity-first (Errors > Warnings > Info) because workflows start with an error. copy inline for fast support flows. Export button should be secondary but visible — maybe right-aligned
Arjun (Eng-runtime): inline copy ok technically. implement as a small icon button with `aria-label=\"Copy correlation ID to clipboard\"` and keyboard target. show a transient toast: \"Trace ID copied\" and include a plain text fallback for screen readers
Sam (Eng-platform): concern: too many icons crowd header on narrow screens. propose responsive behavior: show inline copy on desktop, collapse to a single overflow menu on widths < 720px. we can add telemetry to validate
Lina (Accessibility): accessibility notes: current legend color swatches + captions fail contrast at 12px. target minimum 4.5:1 for caption text or bump to 14px / semi-bold. copy control needs role=button and aria-live region for the copy confirmation. avoid color-only indicators for copied state
Maya (Design): noted. also wording: change the copy affordance tooltip to 'Copy trace ID' (explicit). change the share control label from 'Export permalink' to 'Share link' — reduce ambiguity with file export
Felipe (Product): agree on wording. also for exports: product asks for standardized CSV header ordering: `trace_id, span_id, start_time_ms, duration_ms, service, error_type`. include a version header like `export_v=1` for future changes
Arjun (Eng-runtime): will support CSV + JSONL. JSONL should include full stack frames and tags. default export should redact obvious PII (emails, ip-like patterns). authorized users can opt into full export via an extra param `full_export=true`
Sam (Eng-platform): will add a feature flag to gate full exports and log usage. telemetry: track \"copy_trace_id_click\", \"export_initiated\", and viewport-based collapse decisions so we can measure if collapsing hurts productivity
Lina (Accessibility): keyboard focus: ensure copy button is in logical tab order after primary actions. visible focus ring must meet 3:1 at minimum and not be solely color-based. toast should use `role=\"status\"` and `aria-live=\"polite\"` so adaptive tech announces the copy result
Maya (Design): also proposing legend reorder: [Errors, Requests, Duration, Warnings] — puts error signal first, request counts next, then perf metrics. open to alternate placement if platform needs to keep existing analytics ordering
Felipe (Product): that reorder seems reasonable. we should run a quick hallway test with three engineers to confirm it's intuitive before finalizing
Arjun (Eng-runtime): I'll produce a prototype PR with accessible props and endpoint params `?format=csv|jsonl&redact=true|false`. will also add unit tests asserting aria labels exist
Sam (Eng-platform): I'll stub telemetry and the responsive collapse rule. if within 2 weeks click-through shows >40% inline-copy usage we keep it default else collapse
Maya (Design): thanks — i'll push an updated figma frame with contrast fixes and new labels. will tag @Felipe for the quick test. :smile:
TraceBot: Preview deployed: https://rwd/deploys/trace-header-compact-preview — expires in 72 hours
